env.LEAN_MCP_TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS: {"lean_diagnostic_messages":"Get compiler diagnostics (errors, warnings, infos) for a Lean file. The worker for a file keeps the imports it loaded: after they are rebuilt, what it reports is stale until it is evicted, which querying two other Lean files and then this one does (the server keeps two files open). `Imports are out of date` means the imports on disk are stale; this server never builds them. A call that was waiting on a worker the memory watchdog stopped can return empty, so an empty result after a long elaboration is not evidence of a clean file.","lean_goal":"Get proof goals at a position. Omit column to see goals_before (line start) and goals_after (line end), showing how the tactic transforms the state. An empty goal list means either that no goals remain at that position or that the position holds no tactic state (a term, a comment, or past the end of the proof).","lean_multi_attempt":"Try multiple tactics without modifying file. Returns goal state for each. Every snippet is elaborated, so a list costs the sum of its members.","lean_verify":"Check theorem axioms + optional source scan. Only scans the given file, not imports. The axiom list comes from `#print axioms`, which on Lean v4.30 and later can under-report axioms reached through an imported inductive (lean4#15226): it is a lower bound, and axiom evidence comes only from the from-scratch audit gate of the repository."}
